## User need

What concrete task is poorly supported, and which skill should own it?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful change and why existing instructions are insufficient.

## Evidence and tradeoffs

Provide sanitized examples, success criteria, token/context implications, and scope or compatibility risks.
